Rational verification supplies corroboration, not logical replacement.

value.rationale: The full natural nine-dimensional degree-one real Grassmannian harmonic space has an all-exponent sharp two-sided L2-to-Lp norm geometry and complete spectral equality classification, with a nontrivial reversal at p=2. The endpoint is not an arbitrary coefficient slice or a restatement of known polynomial trace-moment formulae; the strict singular-value envelope gives an exact stability diagnostic.
